description:
HushPine v0.1.1 has 100 patches for PineDrama 47.6.3 (com.ss.android.ttmd.video).

Saved posts from Favorites play in your Dub priority language. Built for PineDrama 47.6.3, so it needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer.

All 100 patches applied to the supported APK. This bundle ran through a whole-app walk of PineDrama on a signed-in Galaxy S22 with no crash.

Needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer. Refresh the HushPine source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a PineDrama APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

### Bug Fixes

* Saved posts opened from Favorites play in your Dub priority language. The post's page doesn't list the video's dubs, so it used to switch the audio back to the original. Right after PineDrama started, a dub request could also get lost before the audio tracks loaded.
